page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.3xlarge is a storage-dense instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The server features 12 vCPUs distributed across 6 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, providing 48.0 GB of system memory. A primary attribute of this configuration is its integrated local storage capacity of 35,433 GB on hard disk drives (HDD). Network connectivity is provisioned at a baseline rate of 4 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor architecture.

Benchmark evaluations highlight a tradeoff between single-thread processing speed and parallel multi-core performance. Single-core execution yields lower scores, such as a Geekbench single-core result of 911.0 and a stress-ng single-core rating of 1102.49. Multi-threaded evaluations demonstrate sustained throughput, recording a PassMark CPU score of 10074.03 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4584.0. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 54.9 GB/sec, while Redis operations process 8.27 million SET commands per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the resource profile prioritizes high storage volume per vCPU rather than maximum compute efficiency or low storage latency. Utilizing local HDDs instead of high-speed solid-state drives minimizes capacity overhead for storage-heavy workloads. Consequently, the ecs.d1.3xlarge is suited for big data analytics, log collection, data warehousing, and long-term file archiving tasks.
